title: Joining Calloway in Springfield, Massachusetts and the trombone seats
summary: He joined on January 8, 1940, replacing DePriest Wheeler, with Tyree Glenn taking Claude Jones's place after Jones and Calloway quarreled.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: We're going to take a break now because now I can join this conversation with you a little bit since you've come into where I came in with you.
Yeah, Butter Brother, so I up booked to Cab Calloway. When do you say it was, December the 8th?
-- I joined that band. You know, I took DePriest Dupreez Wheeler's place and Ty --
Yeah? Oh, he does? Uh-huh -- and Tyree came in in Claude's place.

Now, it was supposed to be originally, it was supposed to be Keg was supposed to go. He was going to keep Claude and let Keg go for Tyree, but Claude started getting drunk or something is the way I heard it -- I don't know because I wasn't there -- and Claude and Calloway had some words and so, instead, he kept Keg and put Tyree in Claude's place.
And I still came in DePriest Dupreez Wheeler's place, you see.
